title: Seville tour from Cadiz port
text: The Seville tour from Cadiz port was wonderful. No issues. We were able to tour the Alcazar with our guide, even though we were late getting our passport details to Spain Day Tours and were advised, therefore, that we likely would not be able to join the group in the Alcazar due to strict entry requirements and capacity controls that are applied to this attraction by the authorities. So we were prepared to tour on our own at a different time. But our guide, speaking in Spanish with gate security, was able to get us in with the group so we got the full tour in English. title: Great Day in Seville with Spain Day Tours!

We both both really enjoyed the tour, it was well worth the money and the savings from booking through the cruise operator was considerable. title: Top Notch Tour Experience
text: This tour company is tops. Guides are friendly, knowledgeable, and focused on needs of their customers. There communication from start to finish is respectful, appreciative, and informative. I cannot say enough about the wonderful experience we had as a valued and respected guest.

title: Seeing Seville thd best way
text:
Excellent value for money. Everything clicked, from pickup outside the cruise port gate to the bus ride with excellent guide and visiting the top sites in Seville.
Highly recommended for cruise passengers who wish to save on the cruise company price and still be guaranteed back onboard ontime.
author: 961juditl

title: Outstanding tours  to Seville and Granada - Spain Day Tours is the company to book !
text: We took 2 fabulous tours with Spain Day Tours on our cruise in October;  Tour from Malaga to  Granada to see  Alhambra and a tour from Cadiz to Seville to see Alcazar.  They deliver what is promised,  and more,  provide excellent information prior to the tour so you know where to go and what to expect  and are easy to communicate with.  Our guides in both ports were terrific; excellent English;  when you arrive at the specific cities/sites, you  are divided into small groups (10-12 people) , provided with your tickets for entry into sites, audio equipment with ear phones, so it is easy to see
author: A5173MCdianew

title: Great tour / amazing sites
text: We really enjoyed the excursion and would recommend.   Everyone on the excursion (43 people on our bus and there were 2 buses) were from our ship and we split into 3 groups for the tour.   Finding the tour in the morning ended up being super convenient as you walk off the ship, out the terminal and port gate and there was an agent standing there with sign directing you.  No real concern getting back on time for us as we were scheduled to get back a few hours before all aboard and we did.
author: Brian_H

title: Royal tour of this royal city
text: Excellent tour of the beautiful and historical city of Seville. Very comfortable coach for the 1 hr 45 ride fr port. Guide Francisco very friendly n knowledgeable-narrating otw. Then split into small groups -our town guide marina was fantastic-she brought the scenes to life-plaza decespana and especially the amazing alcazar royal palace. And had abt 2 hrs free time in the city. All in all a great tour
author: Joseph_F

title: Two great port excursions! 1) Seville and 2) to the Alhambra Palace in Granada from Motril
text: We were on a cruise and booked with Spain Day from Motril port for Granada (Alhambra Palace) and from Cadiz port for Seville (and the Alcazar).  Really great days and a lovely company from booking through to the tour.   Very responsive and clear process in bookings (you need to provide a passport or government ID for tickets to both Alhambra and Alcazar -- apparently tour companies booked up all the tickets and resold at a premium, so those national sites now have individual personalized tickets to try to prevent the mark-up). title: Spain Day Tour to Granada
text: We joined Spain Tours to Granada. The two hour bus trip was interesting and engaging, exploring the story of Spain’s olive industry. The tour of Alhambra Palace was first class, informative, engaging and at a perfect pace. The organisation was exemplary and I wholly recommend Spain Tours. Alhambra was stunning, with gorgeous gardens, breathtaking views and inspiring and colourful architecture.  Thank you.
author: brucesG113AY

title: Spain Day Tours is the best!
text: Perhaps because it is a family run business, our tour from Cadiz port to Seville was the least costly option. It was also flawless. Before booking, Emilia answered all my questions. After the tour, we left something on the bus and Emilia contacted the bus company enabling us to retrieve it. Our guide was excellent. We also booked a Lisbon tour with them.
